message: Astra: Could we set aside the signing correction, still unresolved, and keep your chosen project, “Keep Ya na’s data investigation scene.”, by choosing one investigative exchange to develop next? In your latest revisions, what actually changed on the page, and what remains only intended? With that next step not yet verified, would further thinking about the exchange earn its time over drafting it now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting more valuable? What textual evidence would distinguish those choices? Can you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen intention in English, then carry out that intention?
